features.name: cull-box, entity rotation, sprite frame selection, and sprite quad emission
alias pose, lighting, skin animation, player translation, eye hack, and optional shadow branches
opaque-before-sprite ordering, viewmodel guards and depth range, and canonical polyblend control flow
plane sign bits, frustum setup, frame setup, perspective, GL state, and depth-clear modes
canonical compatibility-fixture scene, mirror, and complete-view orchestration

open_findings: The direct production path still lacks exact frustum/entity culling for arbitrary non-90-degree view rectangles: the compatibility path computes planes, while direct entities.render does not cull alias bounds and original.R_SetFrustum derives a fixed 90-degree horizontal FOV.

The gl_affinemodels branch is represented in compatibility configuration but the native GL wrapper exposes no glHint(GL_PERSPECTIVE_CORRECTION_HINT, ...), so FASTEST/NICEST state changes are not emitted.

The production host path does not register or route all original alias renderer cvars (gl_smoothmodels, gl_affinemodels, r_shadows, gl_nocolors, and typo-preserved gl_doubleeys) through original.R_ConfigureCompatibility.

The production screen blend path does not register or honor gl_polyblend. Its frame order also uses the newly computed V_UpdatePalette blend in the same frame, whereas original SCR_UpdateScreen draws R_PolyBlend first and updates the palette at frame end, so live fullscreen CShift/polyblend is one frame early.
The live mirror path renders the reflected scene but does not reproduce the original mirror-surface blend/composite and texture-chain reset.
Player skin translation exists as R_TranslatePlayerSkin but no live signon/skin-change call site was established in the direct host renderer path.
The GL wrapper quantizes glColor3f/glColor4f to byte channels, while the original alias lighting and blend calls submit floating-point colors.

The six-frame retail screenshot run passes the 0.99 gate at frames 40 and 60 only; frames 80, 100, 120, and 124 remain below threshold due predominantly to particle/explosion, BSP-door-state, and fullscreen-blend differences that cross gl_rmain into other assigned units.
limitations: The strict renderer differential executes all 20 gl_rmain.c bodies against a synthetic pinned-source fixture, but this open review does not treat that compatibility harness as proof that every live production branch is wired.
Physical GL driver rasterization may differ slightly, but the corrected alias mip chain and early static frames now exceed SSIM 0.99 without a weapon-specific no-mip exception.
